## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù treats the *upāya-kauśalya* (大善權, "Great Skillful Means") doctrine — the Mahāyāna teaching that the Buddha employs various skillful methods adapted to the varying capacities of beings.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE). The Taishō text (T0345) is established on a rich apparatus.
